description: Use when: was this BNB token bundled or sniped at launch? For a four.meme or PancakeSwap launch: finds the launch block, reads the next 10 blocks and clusters the wallets that bought in the launch block, were bundled in one tx, got tokens from the dev, or were BNB-funded by the dev or a shared wallet just before launch. Returns % of supply the cluster grabbed, % it still holds, whether the dev is in it, a risk verdict and a coverage field. Failed or timed-out calls are not charged. Costs $0.01.
name: bsc_bundle_sniper_check
